ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity (dark/black) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels; estimated 95:5 distribution on visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark field across primary fluke area with localized high-intensity stippling (white spots) clustered on the medial and distal sections of the right lobe and the extreme distal tip of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 45-degree interior angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; distinct macro-scale indentation (tissue loss) on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical curvature; left lobe exhibits a long, tapering concave sweep toward an acuminate tip; right lobe displays a shorter, steeper convex sweep toward a rounded, bulbous tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white pixels (1-4 pixel diameter) distributed across the right lobe surface and near the right lobe trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch or missing tissue section on the trailing edge of the right lobe, lateral to the median notch; asymmetric truncation of the right lobe tip compared to the left.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe tip exhibits a significantly more rounded and thickened geometry than the sharp, pointed terminus of the left lobe.
